# Pangram Pangram

> A contemporary type foundry offering free-to-try, high-quality fonts designed for modern designers with commercial licensing options.

Pangram Pangram Foundry is a curated collection of typefaces spanning geometric, humanist, and cultural-inspired designs. The foundry emphasizes experimental typography, multilingual support, and variable fonts for contemporary design applications.

## Key Topics

- free-trial fonts

## Font Collections & Discovery

- [Explore All our Free-to-try Fonts | The Full Pangram Pangram® Type Collection](https://pangrampangram.com/collections/fonts): Complete browsable font library with filtering and discovery features
- [Early Access typefaces - All Free to try](https://pangrampangram.com/collections/early-access): Collection of near-complete typefaces available for early testing
- [Pangram Pangram — Free to try, High-Quality Fonts for Designers](https://pangrampangram.com): Homepage showcasing Pangram Pangram Foundry's font catalog and collections

## Typeface Products

- [The Ultimate Font Starter Pack for Designers by Pangram Pangram](https://pangrampangram.com/products/fsp): Font Starter Pack bundle product with commercial licensing options
- [Mori - A workhorse Sans inspired by Japanese design - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/mori): Mori gothic sans-serif with 22 styles inspired by Japanese design
- [Neue York - A Rich Sans rooted in New York City - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/neue-york): Neue York sans-serif inspired by NYC's visual culture and typography
- [PP Museum - Masterfully crafted humanist Sans - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/museum): Museum humanist sans-serif with elegant versatility for any context
- [PP Kyoto - A serif shaped by language and legacy - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/kyoto): Kyoto bilingual slab serif supporting Japanese and Latin characters
- [Paloma - A spritzy humanist sans family - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/paloma): Paloma humanist sans-serif with dual geo-humanist nature
- [Frama - An avant-gardiste geometric font - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/frama): Frama geometric typeface product page with modernist design roots
- [PP Monument - A Powerful Grotesk Sans Family - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/monument): Monument grotesk sans inspired by brutalist architecture with variants
- [PP Watch - Modern, wide, Luxurious Typeface - Free to Try Font](https://pangrampangram.com/products/watch): Watch luxury typeface inspired by Swiss watchmaking precision
- [Neue Corp - Versatile Workhorse Font Free to Try](https://pangrampangram.com/products/neue-corp): Neue Corp multi-width variable typeface for advertising and design
